project_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures

project_metadata.job_title: Luxury Content Creator for Business Pitches and Brochures
project_metadata.job_description: We are seeking a skilled content creator who specializes in crafting luxurious and captivating business pitches, brochures, and portfolios. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail and the ability to convey our brand's values through high-quality content. Your work will be pivotal in impressing stakeholders and clients, so a strong background in luxury branding is essential. Please showcase your previous work that aligns with high-end demands.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please handle several things for me; they are urgent.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I hope you're doing well, nadir belkacem. Hello!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Once you provide the detailed requirements, I can handle the work, so please explain what you need.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: What kind of work do you need? Let me know; it won't be a problem.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Later, I may also need some graphic modifications. For now, I need a business portfolio, brochures, and pitch content with pictures, etc.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: For all the deliverables listed above, could you tell me what you would charge?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Before anything else, what kind of business portfolio do you need? Please let me know.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Once you provide your exact requirements, preferred style, and number of pages or slides, I can give you a final fixed quote.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I've shared a sample for you to review. Now, please tell me about your requirements.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: What I need is something exclusive and tailored for aircraft. Please provide a quote first, and hopefully we can then proceed.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Use this as the reference, but give the new design a nicer feel with less text and more impact.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The portfolios and brochures are needed urgently, while the content can be developed as we move forward. Because we handle multiple things, we might actually need 5 portfolios.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Ok ok

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I can create designs for you that are more attractive and eye-catching. The references are simple designs made in Canva, with neither consistent colors nor a storyline.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For brochure work, I can charge 28$ per brochure. Alternatively, if you want to work with me long term and hire me monthly, the price would be 1200$-1450$.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For the current work, though, my updated rate will be 35$ for each brochure.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Rather than a monthly arrangement, I prefer pricing each content item separately because that will make things easier.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The scope needs 5 portfolios and 7-9 brochures, along with a few pieces of content for social media.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Do you also provide social media services?!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yeah

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes sure

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Is this intended for both Instagram (insta) and Facebook (fb), or only one of them?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: For now, you need 7-9 brochure, so please place the order. I’ll charge 35$ per brochure; with external content, the cost depends on your business’s current ranking. If the business is at the beginning point, I’ll create the content to improve its ranking and engagement, and the charges will be adjusted according to that work.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could you send the logo file? Also, for one portfolio, do you mean only 7-9 items rather than the posts mentioned above?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Please add my number: 202-555-0148.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: on WhatsApp

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Would it be possible to finish everything here, please?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please send me the logo file. Am I right that you need 7-9 brochures delivered in 3 PDF files?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Do you have a color reference for me to follow, or should I make all the color choices?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: size please

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: There are a few outstanding things that I’d like to clarify.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
At this point, the requested workload and revisions have clearly exceeded the original scope, so I cannot continue making changes under the existing terms.

To clarify what that scope was, our initial discussion covered image design only—not a full monthly hiring arrangement, which honestly is not suitable for me at this stage. We agreed on $360 for the work, equivalent to roughly $32 per image/page.

I have tried to remain cooperative and completed multiple requested changes. However, repeatedly requesting major redesigns while describing the work as “template-based” is not accurate: everything was properly created from scratch, and I retain all the original source files.

If you would like further revisions or additional work, the cost will need to be adjusted accordingly. Otherwise, no more changes can be made under the same terms. Thank you for understanding, and please let me know how you would like to proceed.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: From now on, please keep all project communication on Upwork and respond here. I won’t continue any discussions through WhatsApp.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sir?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Excuse me, Sir nadir belkacem.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Why haven’t you replied, Nadir sir?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could you provide the design reference?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: look

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Excuse me again, sir Nadir.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Before I can proceed further, kindly finalize the previous work. If it is not finalized, you may assign the remaining work to someone else. I have also repeatedly asked you to accept the Upwork milestone, but it still has not been accepted.

The total payment is \$480 for more than 55 pages of work, and the project has already taken over four months. Since the work has continued for more than four months, I will need to increase my charges after September 14. Even so, the project remains unapproved and continues to undergo changes, with a significant amount of work still outstanding and the previous tasks not yet finalized.

Under the current setup, I cannot move forward efficiently. At times I am expected to follow Dorian’s instructions and at other times yours. This inconsistency between two different people is not a working style I can continue with, and working under conflicting instructions is not justified. I have cooperated fully from my side, yet my concerns continue to be ignored.

Please understand my situation. I still have other work pending, and remaining stuck on this project will cause a significant loss of my time, effort, and mental focus. If this arrangement suits you, that is fine; if it does not, I kindly request that we wind up the project here.

Thank you for your understanding.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sir Nadir.

messages.text: Are you there.
